rules: Nasal ridge topology is the primary recurring Bajoran species-readable feature.
Ridge number, spacing and relief may vary by individual inside canon-compatible bounds.
Otherwise broad humanlike variation in face, skin tone, hair and body type is preserved.
Religious jewelry, militia uniforms and occupation/resistance styling are culture/organization/history layers, not anatomy.
forbidden_variation: one nasal-ridge template for all Bajorans
notes: Personal faith and resistance history never derive from morphology.
